headline: Highest risk is low: both open-source, non-runnable profiles expose no shared channels, writes, or egress, so pairwise injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are not evidenced.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile exposes an input channel, shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge. awesome-selfhosted is non-runnable and taipy is also non-runnable here, so there is no documented pathway for one agent to ingest the other's outputs as instructions.
conditions: IF either profile later gains a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue bridge, reassess upward.
IF either agent becomes runnable with automatic ingestion of the other's outputs, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep the pair non-runnable in this deployment.
Do not add shared clipboard or workspace mounts.
Require explicit human copy-paste between agents.
Document provenance for any future shared channel.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles show network_egress:none and no data classes touched, so there is no evidenced route for shared data to leak between them or to a third party. The pairwise interaction is undocumented, but the available profile fields block the usual leakage pathways.
conditions: IF either agent begins touching sensitive data classes, reassess upward.
IF either agent gains network egress or shared storage, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep network egress disabled.
Avoid mounting shared workspaces.
Do not route secrets through either agent.
Review any future data-class additions before deployment.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write, network, git, database, or OAuth scopes are present in either profile, and both concurrency_model fields are empty. Without shared mutable resources, there is no plausible capability conflict between awesome-selfhosted and taipy.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory or resource, reassess upward.
IF an orchestrator adds locking-free shared state, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep permissions empty unless needed.
Separate any future writable resources.
Add locking before sharing mutable state.
Avoid co-locating git or database writes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Neither profile shows downstream action authority, and neither has documented outputs that the other consumes. With both agents non-runnable and no evidence bundle, there is no verified chain where taipy would trust awesome-selfhosted's output or vice versa.
conditions: IF one agent's output becomes the other's automated input, reassess upward.
IF either agent gains action-taking authority such as email, commits, or job execution, reassess upward.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Do not auto-feed outputs from one into the other.
Log and review any future handoff format.
Keep both agents read-only in this workflow.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data fields are present, and both profiles touch no data classes. Because the compliance surface is absent in both agents, there is no documented mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are introduced to either agent, reassess compliance.
IF residency or retention requirements are added later, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Record residency and retention requirements before use.
Add a compliance review for any future data flow.
Prefer local-only handling for sensitive content.
